findings.summary: Deferred obligation: wire the committed stub workflow under spikes/dafny-compat/ci/ as a permanent CI job when the CI feature lands (spike suite becomes CI-enforced). The wired job MUST run FROM-CLEAN (rm -rf out / fresh checkout, no cached out/runid-* run roots — a warm out/ masks the AP-021 circular-gate class; this net's absence let both PMB-001 and PMB-002 escape). The stub encodes this (QA-023 note 5), test-asserted. Dischargeable only by the CI feature's spec.
findings.resolution: Realized as a LIVE GitHub Actions job at .github/workflows/dafny-compat-spike.yml (checkout fetch-depth:0 per QA-023 note 1; pinned SDK 10.0.302 installed to $HOME/.dotnet so the documented bare root command resolves it under env -i; `rm -rf spikes/dafny-compat/out` FROM-CLEAN; controller exit is the gate). The former stub spikes/dafny-compat/ci/spike-ci.yml is retained as the co-located requirements charter (test: Inv014OperatorSurfaceTests.CiWorkflow_Realized_LiveJobAndCharter_EncodeFromCleanGate). PENDING: the committed 1800s wall-clock bound must be confirmed sufficient on the ubuntu-latest runner class by the first live run — any bound change goes through DD-006, never a silent edit. Caching (out/cache only) deliberately omitted for a strictly from-clean first wiring.

findings.summary: Deferred obligation: promote ADR-0001 from provisional to accepted (or supersede with counter-evidence) — inherited by the final Phase 0.0 feature's spec.
findings.resolution: ADR-0001 promoted provisional→accepted (P1 of the phase-0.1-worker readiness gate): adr_lint block set to in-process-selected / Route A / COMPATIBLE, anchored to the canonical committed sample; INV-013 AdrLinter returns zero findings for the positive selection (test Inv013AdjudicationTests.AdrLinter_CommittedAdr_WithCommittedSampleRecords_ZeroFindings). Required correcting one linter rule (Components.cs AdrLinter.Lint): a COMPATIBLE verdict no longer requires an adjudication_record_id — adjudication records are a failure-path artifact (AdjudicationStateMachine), so all-pass runs and the frozen canonical sample legitimately carry none (the spike QA-006 catch-22); the committed-evidence PATH remains the anchor and rejection claims still require a record. DD-007 component-table propagation applied in .correctless/ARCHITECTURE.md (core-worker row: drop DafnyPipeline, add DafnyDriver + DafnyLanguageServer for the selected Route A); DESIGN.md 'Dafny publishes'/spike statements are not production-closure claims and are unchanged. RESIDUAL (Phase 0.1 scope, NOT DF-002): INV-003 enforcement-(b) mechanical component-table consistency gate + the readiness-block satisfied:true flip are homed with INV-002 in the not-yet-built build-gate carrier (RS-002 ordering).

findings.title: Uncovered exit/report-matrix cell: child exit 20 + all-pass report maps to COMPATIBLE/exit-0
findings.detail: MapExit default branch assumes a typed cause without checking the report; Aggregate discards the outcome and computes the verdict from the report alone. No current code path can produce the contradiction (child exit derives from the same Results list its report is emitted from); controller exit remains fail-closed. Fix: one MapExit branch + one additive matrix row + one induced test. REMEDIATION (2026-07-27, feature/df-003-remediation): the MapExit exit-20 + all-pass cell now returns ExitReportMismatch (override-admitted, fail-closed) with a fail-closed default; enforced forward-additively by the cross-product test Inv013AdjudicationTests.ExitReportMatrix_CrossProduct_EveryCellDefined_FailureExitAllPassNeverDropped (+ a focused instance test) and an INV-013 spec-enforcement amendment. PENDING before formal resolution: the additive exit_report_matrix schema DOC row is a v3 append-only schema re-anchoring, deferred per OQ-005 (editing the digested schema would regenerate the ancestry-bound evidence samples); status stays open until the P2 completion manifest wires the discharge to the cross-product gate.
findings.disposition: user-deferred at QA round 3 (final) disposition gate, 2026-07-22

findings.title: The MA-UC-4 fix bound the project-enforcement perimeter across 3 copies (sln <-> SpikePath
findings.detail: The MA-UC-4 fix bound the project-enforcement perimeter across 3 copies (sln <-> SpikePaths.Projects <-> run-spike.sh lock-receipt list) but left a 4th unbound: the aggregator's SpikeProjects() (Program.cs), which drives the per-project lockDigests in run-report binding. Consistent today, but on a project addition the sln<->SpikePaths test goes red while SpikeProjects() silently omits the new project's lock digest from evidence - a fail-open narrowing of INV-001 lock-pin binding no test catches.  FIX: Extend the Uc4 test to assert the aggregator's SpikeProjects() name+path set == SpikePaths.Projects. The 'one authoritative source with equality tests against each copy' rule must enumerate ALL copies incl. aggregator-side.
findings.disposition: deferred (round-2 mini-audit LOW; operator-hardening/honesty/latent — no verdict-integrity impact)

findings.title: env-profiles.json still declares SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR as <passthrough> for controlle
findings.detail: env-profiles.json still declares SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR as <passthrough> for controller/provision/fetch/restore/build/test, but MA-HI-1's env -i strips SSL_CERT_* before the inner controller runs, so build_profile_env's passthrough branch always resolves empty. The launches never receive SSL_CERT_*. Not exploitable/fail-closed (fetches are SHA-256-pinned) but the profile advertises a passthrough the MA-HI-1 contract guarantees can never fire, plus a latent portability failure on minimal hosts.  FIX: Drop the two dead <passthrough> keys from the affected classes, OR add SSL_CERT_FILE/DIR to the MA-HI-1 re-exec allowlist if passthrough is wanted. An env-i allowlist and the profile passthrough set must be reconciled by a static check.
findings.disposition: deferred (round-2 mini-audit LOW; operator-hardening/honesty/latent — no verdict-integrity impact)

findings.title: The suite receipt carries source_manifest_sha256 (emitted by run-spike.sh, in the Contract
findings.detail: The suite receipt carries source_manifest_sha256 (emitted by run-spike.sh, in the ContractTypes contract) but the aggregator reads only run_id/nonce/suite_exit - the field is never validated. Not a hole (run_id+nonce already bind the receipt to this run) but it READS like a source-identity binding while providing none (MA-VI-6's 'source-manifest digest binding' is carried but not enforced).  FIX: Cross-check source_manifest_sha256 against run-context.json's source_set_sha256 so the receipt genuinely attests the source the suite validated, OR drop the field. A receipt field emitted but never consumed by its validator should be enforced or removed.
findings.disposition: deferred (round-2 mini-audit LOW; operator-hardening/honesty/latent — no verdict-integrity impact)

findings.title: The MA-HI-3 (json_escape control chars) fix is locked only by a source-scan asserting the
findings.detail: The MA-HI-3 (json_escape control chars) fix is locked only by a source-scan asserting the substitution strings \n/\t/\r appear in the function body. A semantic escaping bug that keeps those strings but mis-orders substitutions (a later backslash-escape double-escaping) would emit invalid JSON and stay green - a hostile-input finding where a cheap behavioral test was feasible.  FIX: Feed a --run-root path (or report value) containing a raw newline through the real write_failed_report path and JsonDocument.Parse the emitted report. Hostile-input JSON-emission fixes get a round-trip (emit->parse) test, never a scan of the escaper body alone.
findings.disposition: deferred (round-2 mini-audit LOW; operator-hardening/honesty/latent — no verdict-integrity impact)

findings.title: The aggregator's --nonce is optional (only --run-id required); every receipt check is 'rec
findings.detail: The aggregator's --nonce is optional (only --run-id required); every receipt check is 'receiptRunId != runId || (nonce.Length>0 && receiptNonce != nonce)', so omitting --nonce degrades all receipt binding (suite/restore/build) to run_id-only, and run_id is not secret (it appears in every on-disk report/receipt). Does not breach MA-VI-6's threat (presence of a suite receipt with suite_exit==0 is the real gate; forging needs run-root write access) but the class-fix intent 'receipt-bound to the run mint, never a bare argv claim' is only as strong as run_id unless --nonce is mandatory.  FIX: Require a non-empty --nonce in the aggregator so binding degrades closed rather than silently to run_id.
findings.disposition: deferred (round-2 mini-audit LOW; operator-hardening/honesty/latent — no verdict-integrity impact)

findings.title: The aggregator terminal summary (advertised in README as 'verdict, failed probes with reas
findings.detail: The aggregator terminal summary (advertised in README as 'verdict, failed probes with reasons, report path - no JSON parsing needed') prints 'route A verdict: INCOMPLETE; failed probes: -' whenever all probes pass but final_suite_status != success (every variance run + the MA-VI-6 canonical downgrade) - StateText renders bare INCOMPLETE with an empty failed-probes list. A summary-only reader sees an unexplained INCOMPLETE with no failed probes; the reason is only in the JSON verdict_reason. MA-VI-6's downgrade adds a canonical path to reach it.  FIX: Append the verdict reason to the summary line for non-probe-failure states, e.g. 'INCOMPLETE (suite-failure: final_suite_status=unknown)'. Any 'no JSON parsing needed' summary renders the reason for every non-COMPATIBLE state.
findings.disposition: deferred (round-2 mini-audit LOW; operator-hardening/honesty/latent — no verdict-integrity impact)

findings.title: run-spike.sh/regen-sample.sh refuse an unhardened (no -p) invocation with exit 30; clean-r
findings.detail: run-spike.sh/regen-sample.sh refuse an unhardened (no -p) invocation with exit 30; clean-runs.sh refuses the same class with exit 20; provision-z3.sh has NO -p self-check at all. Docs are consistent (no doc-vs-code contradiction) but a CI wrapper keying on '30=refused-unhardened vs 20=usage' misclassifies clean-runs' hardening refusal, and standalone provision-z3.sh runs unhardened silently.  FIX: Make clean-runs use exit 30 for the unhardened refusal, add the same -p check + exit 30 to provision-z3.sh. One shared 'refuse unhardened -> exit 30' idiom across all four scripts, asserted by a static test.
findings.disposition: deferred (round-2 mini-audit LOW; operator-hardening/honesty/latent — no verdict-integrity impact)

findings.title: The MA-ED-3 fix_note states the Ed3 test asserts 'no rooted host path (/home,/Users,/tmp,/
findings.detail: The MA-ED-3 fix_note states the Ed3 test asserts 'no rooted host path (/home,/Users,/tmp,/opt,/var)', but the implemented assertion only checks four concrete strings (runId, 'run_directory', runRoot, SpikeRoot). A stable system-rooted path (/opt/dotnet, /usr/share/dotnet) leaking into a class-2 value would not be caught. Determinism impact nil (such paths are run-stable; class-2 path-bearing fields are canonicalized + framework/system assemblies excluded). The code comment is accurate; only the audit-artifact fix_note overstates.  FIX: Align the MA-ED-3 fix_note wording to what Ed3 checks, OR add a generic rooted-path regex (^/(opt|var|usr|home|Users|tmp)/ or drive-letter) over the raw class-2 subtree. A 'no rooted path in class-2' assertion should test generically, not by enumerating known roots.
findings.disposition: deferred (round-2 mini-audit LOW; operator-hardening/honesty/latent — no verdict-integrity impact)

findings.title: list_descendant_sessions lacks the sess==candidate leader-guard its sibling find_session_l
findings.detail: list_descendant_sessions lacks the sess==candidate leader-guard its sibling find_session_leader has: for candidate==ancestor it emits sid[candidate] unconditionally. Harmless today because setsid -w (no -f, job control off) doesn't fork so WRAPPER_PID is the inner session leader. Latent: if the setsid call ever forks (adding -f, set -m, or setsid already a group leader), sid[WRAPPER_PID] becomes the OUTER session, and on operator cancel the trap kills -TERM/-KILL -<parent-session> - signaling the outer watchdog's own group, potentially killing the run before the OperatorCancelled synthetic is written. UNCERTAIN (not triggerable in the current invocation contract).  FIX: In list_descendant_sessions, continue when candidate==ancestor, or emit only when sid[candidate]==candidate (mirror find_session_leader). Session-sweep enumerators share one leader-identification helper.
findings.disposition: deferred (round-2 mini-audit LOW; operator-hardening/honesty/latent — no verdict-integrity impact)

findings.title: Determinism-lane fixture drives the two-nested-run lane via ManagedLauncher's hardcoded 600s cap
findings.detail: DeterminismLaneFixture (Launch.cs:182) uses a 600s launcher cap, 9x smaller than the 90-min job budget and the nested runs' own 1800s self-budget. Legit determinism taking >600s -> SIGKILL(137) -> Receipt null -> RequireReceipt Assert.True(ExitCode==0) fails ALL lane tests -> the sanctioned >=8-core lane can be permanently RED on WORKING determinism. Fix: raise/parameterize the lane fixture launcher timeout, coordinated with the job budget.
findings.disposition: mini-audit round 1, HIGH (tier-3, test-infra); PR1 not a current fail-open; CI-reliability pre-landing item (sibling of QA-003 / task #56)
findings.resolution: Fixed on the feature branch pre-landing: Launch.LaneScript with a job-coordinated LaneTimeoutSeconds=4800 (the DeterminismLaneFixture uses it); guard test asserts the cap exceeds 2×1800s and stays under the 90-min job backstop.

findings.title: The only executing end-to-end coverage for INV-001/002/005 lives on a non-required, unverified 8-core lane
findings.detail: INV-001/002/005 (incl the receipt-binds-to-real-artifacts test) execute only on the org-provisioned ubuntu-24.04-8core lane, which is NOT a required check, has no runner-existence verification, no fallback, and no red signal if it never runs. The from-clean lane STEP checks only exit code, not receipt content. 'Runs for real in CI' is asserted but not enforced/provable. Fix: runner-existence/floor assertion + make the lane a required check or loud-fail if the runner never materializes.
findings.disposition: mini-audit round 1, HIGH (tier-3, ci-config); CI-reliability pre-landing item (sibling of QA-003 / task #56)
findings.resolution_progress: PARTIAL (feature branch pre-landing): committed the LOUD-FAIL floor assertion (nproc < core_floor -> exit 1) + a receipt-emitted content guard + structural CI-config tests (Pr1CiSeparationTests). RESIDUAL (status kept open): making the lane a REQUIRED check is a repo branch-protection setting, not in-repo YAML — a repo-admin action.

findings.title: Resource floor enforced only in the test fixture, not in production determinism-lane.sh
findings.detail: The core_floor (=8) is enforced only by Pr1DeterminismLaneTests.cs:47 (<8 skip), NOT production. determinism-lane.sh + the workflow record the core count but never compare/skip; Build can never emit resource_floor_skipped. Below-floor -> lane runs anyway -> CPU-flap mislabeled comparison_status=different (which INV-001 forbids for infra faults) instead of INV-004's resource_floor_skipped. Fail-closed (red, no false mint) but mislabels. RS-009 'default outcome completed' + all-skip alarm unimplemented.

findings.title: INV-003 different->non-zero-exit chain has zero executing coverage above the pure classifier
findings.detail: All INV-003 tests use synthetic ReceiptStatus/hand-built evidence [unit]; no test drives RunCli/Build/determinism-lane.sh with a corpus yielding different. Real runs only ever produce equal, so the different branch is not CI-observed. Comment Pr1Inv003DisagreementTests.cs:76 'lane-covered (CI-observed)' is inaccurate for different. findings.title: campaign-rows.json head_sha are feature-branch-only; a squash-merge breaks the general-gate ancestry test
findings.detail: campaign-rows.json head_sha (be50f9a/95a0982/6d42cd2) are feature-branch-only, not reachable from origin/main. The ancestry test Pr1Inv004ResourceFloorTests.cs:47 has NO category trait -> runs in the GENERAL gate. On a SQUASH-merge these SHAs become main-unreachable -> git merge-base --is-ancestor exit 128 -> PlanPredatesRun false -> RED on main. Holds today (repo uses merge-commits) but undocumented; fails closed. Overlaps QA-003 (the PENDING placeholders will re-pin to main commits). Fix: re-pin head_sha to main-reachable OR document the non-squash requirement.

findings.title: ResolveHeadCommit uncomputable-HEAD -> attested_commit='unknown' is not a hard failure (PR2/PR3)
findings.detail: DeterminismReceiptWriter.cs:325-340: an uncomputable HEAD yields attested_commit='unknown' (a string), not a hard failure; a (Completed,Equal) receipt with attested_commit=unknown is still exit0/MintEligible. Benign in PR1 (signs nothing) but must map to rejected when PR2/PR3 consume it (cf EA-007/INV-012 ancestry-uncomputable -> rejected).

findings.title: RunReceiptCodec.Parse reads execution/comparison independently, never checks pair legality
findings.detail: RunReceiptCodec.Parse (DeterminismStatusModel.cs:720) reads execution_status + comparison_status independently, never checks the pair vs IsLegalStatusPair or ValidateReport. A receipt {infrastructure_invalid, equal} parses cleanly (INV-001's named Violated-when). NOT exploitable in PR1 (Dispose whitelists (Completed,Equal)) but is the PR2/PR3 parse surface. Fix: post-parse IsLegalStatusPair reject.
findings.disposition: mini-audit round 1 (tier-2, production-latent); PR2/PR3 parse surface, not exploitable in PR1

findings.title: BuildRunEvidence/DeterministicProjection never runs ValidateReport on the r1/r2 role reports
findings.detail: DeterminismReceiptWriter.cs:256 projects r1/r2 role reports without EvidenceSchema.ValidateReport (the aggregator does, Program.cs:360). Projection only throws on present-but-unclassified fields; not required/type/enum. Two runtime reports sharing a schema defect project identically -> equal -> mint-eligible. Most 'live' seam (r1/r2 runtime-produced, no from-clean content test). Latent (PR1 mints nothing). Fix: ValidateReport before projecting.
findings.disposition: mini-audit round 1 (tier-2, production-latent); latent, PR1 mints nothing

findings.title: DeterminismComparison.Compare returns equal vacuously on an empty role/kind registry
findings.detail: Compare returns equal vacuously on an empty role/kind registry (empty SetEquals passes; the projection loop over empty leaves allProjectionsAgree=true). Only the external cardinality test (RoleRegistry_HasExactlyFiveRoles) guards the committed path, not a code-level assertion (AP-022/RS-016 empty-set-degeneracy). Fix: committedRoles.Count==0 || committedKinds.Count==0 -> NotEvaluated in Compare.
findings.disposition: mini-audit round 1 (tier-2, production-latent); committed path guarded by the cardinality test

findings.title: Lane fixture resolves the SDK only via the workflow-seeded out/cache/dotnet-root pointer
findings.detail: DeterminismLaneFixture resolves the SDK only via the workflow-seeded out/cache/dotnet-root pointer (empty env, no --dotnet-root). A bare 'dotnet test --filter Category=determinism-lane' from a fresh clone -> exit 3 -> RED for a provisioning gap. DOWNGRADED (MA-FC-002): the pointer is seeded within the same job in all passing paths, fail-closed, NOT leaked prior-run state -- an expected hidden coupling, not a from-clean hole. Fix: document the seeding coupling, or have the fixture seed / pass --dotnet-root.
findings.disposition: mini-audit round 1 (tier-3, doc); downgraded to expected hidden coupling (fail-closed, not leaked state)

findings.title: Lane exit table omits exit 30 (run-spike unhardened) and emitter exit 2 (unknown arg)
findings.detail: The lane exit table omits exit 30 (run-spike unhardened via set -e) and emitter exit 2 (unknown arg). Verified PRACTICALLY UNREACHABLE via the committed lane (bash -p hardened; env -i strips DETERMINISM_* before the non-allowlist assert; fixed emitter argv). Worth a table footnote, not urgent.

findings.title: p3-determinism-lane.yml 'floor-capable assertion' comment overstates -- the step only echoes cores
findings.detail: p3-determinism-lane.yml:68-79 'floor-capable assertion' comment overstates: the step only echoes core_floor/observed_cores, no if/exit. Real enforcement is the xUnit throw (indirect). On a mis-mapped runner the from-clean step can write a completed+equal receipt recording processor_count=4 + exit 0 (the job still reds later). Receipt not self-describing below-floor. Ties RS-009 / MA-RB-1. Fix: a real floor check at lane start and/or a below-floor marker in the receipt.

findings.title: projection_impl_digest _impl_pin_comment omits the schema as a hidden third input
findings.detail: projection_impl_digest = SHA256(DeterministicProjection(vector, SCHEMA)); DeterministicProjection reads the schema partition, so the schema is a hidden 3rd input. The map's _impl_pin_comment tells operators to recompute 'if the projection code or vector changes' -- OMITS the schema. A schema edit for an unrelated subsystem stales the pin -> Compare rejects every real receipt -> P3 unmintable until recomputed. Fail-loud (ProjectionImplDigest test), so fragility+doc-gap, not silent. Fix: add 'or the schema' to the comment; consider a P3-owned frozen vector.
findings.disposition: mini-audit round 1 (tier-4, doc); fail-loud, doc-gap only

findings.title: Receipt policy_version defaults to '1'; subject_manifest_digest defaults to the evidence-schema digest
findings.detail: Receipt policy_version defaults to literal '1' (DeterminismReceiptWriter.cs:45); subject_manifest_digest defaults to Sha256File(schemaPath) (the evidence-schema digest again, not a policy-map/subject-manifest digest). projection-policy-map.json has no version field. Mostly PR2-scoped (PR1 signs nothing). PR2 receipt-evolution note.
findings.disposition: mini-audit round 1 (tier-4, design-latent); PR2 receipt-evolution

findings.detail: os_label degrades to hardcoded 'ubuntu-24.04' when --os-label/$DETERMINISM_OS_LABEL absent (DeterminismReceiptWriter.cs:298), unlike runner_image's honest 'local-dev-nonci-runner' marker. findings.title: CI-separation dry-run residual net rests on an unpinned ubuntu-latest < core_floor=8 assumption
findings.detail: The CI-separation dry-run residual net ('dropped filter -> lane tests throw below floor -> red') rests on an UNPINNED ubuntu-latest < core_floor=8 assumption. If GitHub bumps ubuntu-latest to >=8 vCPU, a dropped filter would run the heavyweight lane on the general gate instead of throwing -> the net weakens. Deepens QA-001..013. Fix: pin the general gate vCPU or assert nproc<core_floor at gate start.
findings.disposition: mini-audit round 1 (tier-4, ci-latent); net holds under current runner sizing. (Pure-INFO items MA-FC-002 and MA-ID-005 intentionally NOT logged -- both explicitly 'not a hole / noted for completeness' in the mini-audit artifact.)

findings.title: acquire_out_lock stale-lock reclaim has a mkdir-TOCTOU window (pre-existing, out of PR1 scope)
findings.detail: run-spike.sh acquire_out_lock's stale-lock reclaim path has a mkdir-based TOCTOU window between judging a lock dir stale and reclaiming it. Fail-closed and PRE-EXISTING (not introduced by PR1). Surfaced by /caudit qa round 1 (concurrency lens). Deferred per user disposition 'Fix A-G, defer H'. Fix: make the stale-reclaim atomic (rename-into-place, or a single mkdir with an owner token verified after acquisition).
findings.disposition: caudit qa round 1 (concurrency lens); pre-existing shell lock race, fail-closed; out of PR1 scope.
